page.title: Skill Centre
page.subtitle: Manage installed skills and MCP servers, or add new ones from the store.

mine.emptyHint: Pick something from the store, or upload your own.

install.title: Install
install.dependsTitle: This skill needs an MCP server
install.dependsHint: Its instructions call tools these servers provide. Without them the skill loads and then fails at its first tool call.
install.dependsWarning: Some dependencies are unchecked — the skill may not work.

upload.title: Add a skill or MCP server
upload.subtitle: Upload an archive, paste a SKILL.md, install from git, or configure an MCP server.
upload.frontmatterHint: Frontmatter supports icon (an emoji) and requires-mcp (MCP server names it depends on).
upload.gitHint: https, git or ssh. An install.sh in the repo runs automatically.
upload.remoteHint: Remote servers try Streamable HTTP first and fall back to SSE.
upload.jsonHint: Accepts an mcpServers / servers wrapper, or a single server object.

jsonError.invalidShape: Unrecognised shape — paste a server object or an mcpServers map.
jsonError.noServers: No MCP servers found in that configuration.
jsonError.needName: A single server object needs a name.
